name: peer-chat
description: Claude Code and Codex hold a conversation in one agterm split, each typing into the other's composer. Claude opens the Codex pane itself when a decision would benefit from an adversary: a design with two defensible options, a diagnosis nobody has tried to disprove, a diff about to ship unreviewed. Vendors umputun/agterm's two-agent-chat recipe (MIT) and adds the spawn step, an installer for the Codex side, and an upstream sync script. Requires the agterm terminal 0.24.0+ (macOS), python3, jq, and the codex CLI.
